shared_elements: detailed hair and beard rendering with regular incised curls
figure holding an object in the hand
registers bounded by horizontal framing lines
justification: Both are low-relief profile scenes with human figures in patterned garments, careful incised curls of hair/beard, and objects held in the hand, and both organise the field with horizontal framing lines — a shared convention of profile figural relief. But A shows a single large winged, horned-crowned figure with elaborate feathered wings filling the panel, while B shows a small attendant leading a naturalistic two-humped camel between rosette borders, so the actual subjects, relationships (leading an animal vs. a solitary raised-arm figure) and register arrangement differ substantially.
